topics.name: Relation Type Identity
topics.purpose: Define every semantic relation type as an explicit identity with source/target types, cardinality, direction and ownership.

semantics.identity_rule: Each relation type has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.source_rule: Allowed source type identities are explicit.
semantics.target_rule: Allowed target type identities are explicit.
semantics.ownership_rule: Relation type owner is explicit and does not transfer endpoint ownership.
semantics.inverse_rule: Inverse relation identity/ref is explicit where defined.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
